**Multi-step forecasting can reuse one prediction recursively or learn horizons directly.** A recursive model predicts tomorrow, feeds that prediction back, then predicts the next day. It is compact, but an early error becomes a later input and can compound. [1](https://otexts.com/fpp3/)

Direct forecasting trains a separate predictor for each horizon. It avoids feeding its own errors forward but can require many models and produce inconsistent trajectories. Joint forecasting outputs the whole horizon together, sharing information across future steps.

**Architecture names do not settle the distinction.** A sequence-to-sequence model may still decode recursively, while another predicts a vector in parallel. Specify whether later outputs condition on earlier predicted values.

Use rolling-origin evaluation and report error by horizon, trajectory coherence, and uncertainty. Only provide future covariates actually known at the forecast origin; realized future weather is not available merely because it exists in the historical table. Compare the strategy under realistic missing inputs and compute constraints. The best one-step model need not be the best long-horizon system.

**Technical details and references.**

Direct forecasting trains a separate model for each horizon, avoiding recursive error propagation but requiring more models and potentially inconsistent trajectories. Recursive forecasting repeatedly applies a one-step model and feeds predictions back as inputs; it shares parameters efficiently but accumulates errors and sees a different input distribution from training. Joint/vector forecasting predicts the full horizon together, sharing information and modeling dependencies across steps. [1](https://otexts.com/fpp3/)

Choose using rolling-origin validation at each operational horizon, not a random split. Provide only covariates known at the forecast origin; future observed weather or realized promotions can leak information. Compare trajectory coherence, per-horizon error, intervals, compute, and robustness to missing inputs. A seq2seq model can itself decode recursively, so distinguish architecture from whether inference conditions on earlier predicted outputs.
